caption: How autoresearch works with hi agent best-of. You give a task and, for rounds, a score command. Each round, hi starts several boxes from the same commit, the best so far, each with its own agent and branch. When an agent ends, hi itself runs your check and your score on the files it left, and discards results that changed files outside --edit. Only hi commits: a result goes on the run's own branch only when it beats the best so far. The next round's task tells the agents the best score and what every earlier attempt tried, until a limit you set.
